intro.heading: Artists and technicians, working for your art.
intro.body: Matr was started by artists, and the studio still runs on that instinct. Every finish we offer was developed alongside artists, to make their work look its best. Choose how you want to work with us.

beyond.heading: Beyond the edition
beyond.lead: Texture, surfaces and finishes over and above the Oil Edition. Tell us what you have in mind.

pro.heading: Your work, produced at scale.
pro.body: We'd like to hear from artists and studios who need their images produced in quantity. We develop the look with you through samples, then produce and deliver the edition. An upfront development fee covers the sampling; volume pricing earns it back.
pro.alt: A print bed laid out with a run of pieces under the print head
